posts.title: Bibliothèque du Rosey
posts.description: Since 2014, an UFO has landed on the lawn of this elite boarding school. Its futuristic shapes conceal a large concert hall, creative spaces and the institute's library.

posts.title: Jesus College Quincentenary Library, Cambridge
posts.description: Celebrating 500 years of college education, this library blends contemporary technology with ancient forms to provide a space uniquely suited for study.

posts.title: Universitätsbibliothek BOKU Wien
posts.description: Part greenhouse, part sanatorium, this unusual glass extension of a Vienna Reformstil hospital hosts the library of the university of natural resources and life sciences.
